help.faq.journal-private-photos.question: Ngingagcina yini izithombe eziyimfihlo?
help.faq.journal-private-photos.subtitle: Ukulandelela ushintsho oluthile olubonakalayo.
help.faq.journal-private-photos.answer: Yebo. Izithombe eziyimfihlo ezivikelekile ziyatholakala, isibonelo ukulandelela ukuthi ubuhlungu bebuso, ukukhula kwezinviyo noma izimpawu zesikhumba kushintsha kanjani.
help.faq.security-private-data.question: I-AWA ivikela kanjani idatha yami?
help.faq.security-private-data.subtitle: Ubumfihlo, ukuphepha nokuqoqwa okuncane.
help.faq.security-private-data.answer: I-AWA yakhelwe ekuqoqweni kwedatha okuncane, ngaphandle kwesikhangiso esiqondiswe umuntu, ngaphandle kokuthengisa idatha yomuntu, nokugcinwa okuphephile ngokubethela kwangempela kwedatha ebucayi.
help.faq.security-export.question: Ngingayithumela yini ngaphandle idatha yami?
help.faq.security-export.subtitle: Ukuthumela ngaphandle nge-PDF ne-CSV kuyasekelwa.
help.faq.security-export.answer: Yebo. Ukuthumela ngaphandle ukulandelela kwakho nge-PDF kanye nedatha yakho nge-CSV kuyatholakala, ukuze wakhe umlando ocacile, nokuyisa kochwepheshe bezempilo.
help.faq.security-delete.question: Ngingayisusa kalula yini idatha yami?
help.faq.security-delete.subtitle: Ukususa kuhlala kulula futhi kutholakala.
help.faq.security-delete.answer: Yebo. Ukususa kalula idatha yakho ne-akhawunti kuyatholakala kuzilungiselelo ezifanele.
help.guides.getting-started.title: Ukuqalisa nge-AWA
help.guides.getting-started.text: Thola isikrini sakho sasekhaya, ikhalenda, ijenali, inhloso yakho nezimpawu zokholo.
help.guides.cycle.title: Ukulandelela umjikelezo
help.guides.cycle.text: Qopha isikhathi sakho, ukugeleza, futhi ubheke ukulinganisa komjikelezo wakho.
help.guides.conceive.title: Ukuzama ukukhulelwa
help.guides.conceive.text: Landelela ukuzala, i-ovulation, izinga lokushisa lomzimba, ubuthi bomlomo wesibeletho nokuhlolwa kwe-LH.
help.guides.contraception.title: Ukuvikela ukukhulelwa
help.guides.contraception.text: Lawula indlela yakho, izikhumbuzo, amadosi akhohliwe nomlando wokuphuza.
help.guides.irregular.title: Imijikelezo engahleliwe / PCOS
help.guides.irregular.text: Phawula imijikelezo engahleliwe, ubuhlungu bebuso, ukukhula kwezinviyo, isisindo nezimpawu ezihlobene.
help.guides.menopause.title: Perimenopause / Menopause
help.guides.menopause.text: Landelela ukushisa kwesikhashana komzimba, ukulala, ukukhathala, isimo sengqondo nokwelashwa nge-hormone.
help.guides.pregnancy.title: Ukulandelela ukukhulelwa
help.guides.pregnancy.text: Landelela usuku lwakho lokubeletha, amaviki, izikhathi zokubona udokotela, ukuhlolwa nezimpawu.
help.guides.postpartum.title: Ngemuva kokubeletha
help.guides.postpartum.text: Landelela i-lochia, ukubuya komjikelezo, ukuncelisa, ukulala, isimo sengqondo nokululama.
help.guides.loss.title: Ngemuva kokuphunyelwa yisisu
help.guides.loss.text: Landelela ukopha, izimpawu, nokubuya komjikelezo wakho ngesivinini sakho.
help.guides.calendar.title: Ukusebenzisa ikhalenda
help.guides.calendar.text: Qonda izikhathi, ukulinganisa, izikhombi, nokubonisa ngekhalenda lakwamanye amazwe / likaHijri.
help.guides.journal.title: Ukugcwalisa ijenali yakho yansuku zonke
help.guides.journal.text: Qopha izimpawu, isimo sengqondo, ukulala, ukuzivocavoca, amanothi nobunye.
help.guides.spiritual.title: Ukusebenzisa izimpawu zokholo
help.guides.spiritual.text: Thola ikhalenda likaHijri, ukuhlanzeka, salat, ukuzila, i-qadaa ne-nifas.
help.guides.privacy.title: Ubumfihlo nedatha
help.guides.privacy.text: Lawula ukuphepha, imodi eyimfihlo, ukuthumela ngaphandle, ukubethela nokususwa kwedatha.
help.helpSupport.title: Usizo nokusekelwa
help.helpSupport.subtitle: Unombuzo? Silapha ukukusiza.
help.helpSupport.supportText: Khetha indlela yokuxhumana ekufanele, noma ubheke izimpendulo ezivame kakhulu.
help.helpSupport.guidesSubtitle: Thola imihlahlandlela yethu ukuze uzuze kakhulu ku-AWA.
help.helpSupport.feedbackSubtitle: Yabelana ngemicabango yakho ukuze usisize sithuthukise uhlelo.
help.helpSupport.bannerTitle: Okuhlangenwe nakho kwakho kusisiza sithuthukise i-AWA
help.faqScreen.title: Imibuzo evame ukubuzwa
help.faqScreen.intro: Thola izimpendulo ezibalulekile zokusebenzisa i-AWA ngokunethezeka.
help.guidesScreen.title: Imihlahlandlela nezifundo
help.whatsNewScreen.title: Okusha
help.whatsNewScreen.heading: I-AWA iyaqhubeka nokukhula
help.whatsNewScreen.body: Azikabekwa izinothi ezisemthethweni zokukhishwa. Izibuyekezo ezizayo ziyovela lapha lapho sezishicilelwe.

library.religiousDisclaimer: Lokhu okuqukethwe kungokokufundisa kuphela. Imibuzo yenkolo kufanele iqinisekiswe izazi ezifanelekile. I-AWA ayikhiphi ama-fatwa noma izinqumo zenkolo eziqondiswe umuntu.
library.articles.cycle-comprendre-ton-cy: Izigaba eziyinhloko zomjikelezo wakho, zichazwe kalula.
library.articles.cycle-phases-expliquees: I-estrogen ne-progesterone: okwenzeka ngempela iviki ngalinye.
library.articles.cycle-signe-vital.title: Umjikelezo wakho, ifasitela langempela lempilo yakho
library.articles.cycle-signe-vital.summa: Kungani umjikelezo kwesinye isikhathi ubizwa ngokuthi "uphawu lwesihlanu lokubaluleka kwempilo."
library.articles.firstperiod-premiers-si: Izimpawu zokuqala ngaphambi kokuba isikhathi sakho sifike
Ushintsho lomzimba, ukuphuma, isimo sengqondo: izimpawu zokuthi isikhathi sakho sokuqala siyeza.
library.articles.firstperiod-comment-sav: Ngiyazi kanjani ukuthi isikhathi sami sokuqala siyeza?
Ukubona izimpawu ezibambekayo, nokwazi ukuthi ukhulume nini nomuntu omdala.
library.articles.firstperiod-choisir-pro: Yikuphi ukuvikela okufanele ngikhethe esikhathini sami sokuqala?
Amapedi, izingubo zangaphakathi zesikhathi, ama-tampon: ukuqonda ukukhetha ngokukhululeka kwakho.
library.articles.firstperiod-gerer-quoti: Ukuphatha isikhathi sakho sokuqala usuku nosuku
Isikole, ezemidlalo, ukulala: izimiso ezimbalwa ezilula zokuhlala unethezekile.
library.articles.firstperiod-cycle-irreg: Izikhathi zami zokuqala azihleliwe: ingabe kujwayelekile?
Kungani umjikelezo uthatha isikhathi ukuzinza, nokuthi ubone nini udokotela.
library.articles.firstperiod-questions-f: Izimpendulo ezilula zemibuzo evame kakhulu ngezikhathi zokuqala.
library.articles.flow-comprendre-flux.su: Ukugeleza okulula, okumaphakathi noma okuningi: ukuthi lokhu kwehluka kusho ukuthini.
library.articles.flow-hygiene-intime.tit: Ukunakekela inhlanzeko yakho yangasese ngesikhathi sakho
library.articles.flow-hygiene-intime.sum: Izimiso ezilula zokuzizwa unethezekile ngenkathi uhlonipha umzimba wakho.
library.articles.flow-colors-textures.su: Umbala nesimo sesikhathi sakho kuthi okuningi ngempilo yakho ye-hormone.
library.articles.symptoms-reconnaitre.su: Amabele abuthakathaka, ukuvuvukala kwesisu, ukukhathala: kuvelaphi.
library.articles.fertility-fenetre-ferti: Kungani izinsuku ezingu-6 ezizungeze i-ovulation zibaluleke kakhulu ekukhulelweni.
library.articles.ovulation-comprendre-ov: Isikhathi esiyinhloko somjikelezo wakho, nokuthi singabonakala kanjani.
library.articles.pain-gerer-douleurs.sum: Ukushisa, ukunyakaza okuthambile, ukudla: izimiso ezisiza ngempela.
library.articles.hydration-bien-shydrate: Ukuhlala uphuze amanzi anele kuyo yonke imijikelezo yakho
Kungani ukuphuza amanzi amaningi kunciphisa ukuvuvukala kwesisu ngaphambi kwesikhathi.
Kungani ukulala kwakho kushintsha ngokwesigaba somjikelezo wakho, nase-menopause.
library.articles.mood-humeur-et-hormones: Kungani isimo sakho sengqondo sishintsha emjikelezweni wakho nasempilweni yakho yonke.
library.articles.basaltemp-suivre-temper: Indlela elula yokuqinisekisa ukuthi i-ovulation isenzekile.
library.articles.cervicalmucus-observer-: Uphawu lwemvelo, olungenamali, lokubona iwindi lakho lokuzala.
library.articles.lhtests-comprendre-test: Lezi zicucu zokuhlola zisebenza kanjani nokuthi zisetshenziswe nini.
library.articles.nutrition-conception-fe: Imisoco esekela umjikelezo ozalayo nokukhulelwa okunempilo.
library.articles.conceptiontips-essayer-: Izikhombi eziyisisekelo zokuqala uhambo lwakho lokukhulelwa ngokunethezeka.
library.articles.conceptiontips-comprend: Okwenzeka phakathi kokuvundiswa kweqanda nokuhlolwa okuhle.
library.articles.conceptiontips-hygiene-: Izimiso ezilula ezingasekela uhambo lwakho, ngaphandle kwengcindezi.
library.articles.birthcontrolpills-compr: Ipilisi lisebenza kanjani, nezinto eziyinhloko ezifanele ukwaziwa ngaphambi kokulikhetha.
library.articles.patch-le-patch-contrace: Enye indlela yeviki ngalinye esikhundleni sepilisi lansuku zonke.
library.articles.hormonaltreatments-pano: Ukubuka konke ukwelashwa kokuvikela ukukhulelwa nge-hormone
Ipilisi, i-patch, indandatho, i-implant, i-IUD ye-hormone: okuyehlukanisayo.
library.articles.missedpills-que-faire-e: Lokho okufanele ukwenze kuncike kakhulu ekutheni ulikhohlwe kudala kangakanani.
library.articles.sideeffects-reconnaitre: Ukubona imiphumela emibi engase ibe khona
library.articles.pcos-comprendre-sopk.su: I-polycystic ovary syndrome, icaciswe: yini, ukuthi yehluka kangakanani phakathi kwabesifazane, nokuthi ungafunda kuphi okwengeziwe.
library.articles.pcos-cycle-ovulation-fe: Kungani umjikelezo ungahleliwe nge-PCOS, nokuthi lokho kusho ukuthini ekuzaleni.
library.articles.pcos-peau-pilosite-symp: Kungani i-PCOS ingathinta isikhumba nezinviyo zakho, nokuthi uzinakekele kanjani.
library.articles.pcos-diagnostic-examens: I-PCOS ixilongwa kanjani, nokuthi ulungiselele kanjani isikhathi sakho sokubona udokotela.
library.articles.pcos-poids-metabolisme-: Ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-PCOS, isisindo nokumelana ne-insulin, ngaphandle kokwahlulela noma izindlela eziqondile.
library.articles.pcos-mode-de-vie-prise-: Izinketho zokuphatha i-PCOS, nezimiso ezilula zokusekela impilo yakho yansuku zonke.
library.articles.pcos-acne-hormonale.sum: Kungani ubuhlungu bebuso be-hormone bungavela nge-PCOS, ukubabona, nokuthi yiziphi izixazululo ezingasiza ukubaphatha.
library.articles.hormones-menopause-equi: I-estrogen, i-progesterone, i-FSH, i-LH: ashintsha kanjani nokuthi kungani izimpawu zehluka.
library.articles.exercise-bouger-pour-le: Kungani ukunyakaza njalo kungasekela umjikelezo wakho, yiluphi uhlobo lomsebenzi olukhethwayo, nokuthi ulungise kanjani isivinini sakho ngaphandle kwengcindezi.
library.articles.exercise-bouger-enceint: Yimaphi amanyathelo ahlala ephephile futhi enenzuzo.
library.articles.pregnancy-semaine-par-s: Izigaba eziyinhloko kusukela ku-trimester yokuqala kuya kweyesithathu.
library.articles.babydevelopment-develop: Usana lwakho lukhula kanjani, i-trimester ngayinye.
library.articles.childbirthprep-preparer: Ukuphefumula, izindlela zokuma, nesikhwama sakho sasesibhedlela: okubalulekile.
library.articles.postpartum-retour-de-co: Ukubuya kwesikhathi sakho ngemuva kokubeletha: okufanele ukulindele
Lapho isikhathi sakho sibuya ngemuva kokubeletha.
library.articles.lochia-comprendre-lochi: Lokhu kopha kwangemuva kokubeletha, nokuthi kuvamise ukushintsha kanjani.
Lo mbandela ubhekisele kukuphi emzimbeni, nokuthi uzinakekele kanjani.
library.articles.breastfeeding-debuter-a: Ukuqala, isigqi, nezimpawu okufanele uzinake ezinsukwini zokuqala.
library.articles.emotionalhealth-baby-bl: I-baby blues nempilo yemizwa ngemuva kokubeletha
Ukwehlukanisa i-baby blues yesikhashana nokucindezeleka ngemuva kokubeletha.
library.articles.lossemotional-traverser: Alikho ithuba elilodwa elilungile lokudlula kulesi sivivinyo.
library.articles.lossfertility-fertilite: Nini nokuthi kanjani ucabangele ukuzama futhi.
library.articles.menopause-comprendre-la: Okushintsha kancane kancane, iminyaka ngaphambi kokuba isikhathi sakho siphele.
library.articles.treatments-traitements-: Ukwelashwa nge-hormone nezinye izindlela ezingezona ze-hormone, ngamafuphi.
Ukubuka konke izihloko eziyinhloko ze-fiqh yabesifazane, phakathi kokukhulekela nempilo yansuku zonke.
library.articles.menstruationpurity-stat: Ukuqonda ukuxhumana phakathi komjikelezo nokuhlanzeka, ukuze usondele kulesi sikhathi ngokuqonda okwengeziwe.
library.articles.istihada-comprendre-les: Ukwehlukanisa ukopha okungahleliwe nesikhathi esijwayelekile, ngezikhombi ezivamile zokukuhola.
library.articles.nifasfiqh-repere-fiqh.s: Ukuqonda i-nifas, ubude bayo, salat, ukuzila, nokuqala kabusha ukukhulekela ngemuva kokubeletha.
library.articles.ramadan-jeune-et-regles: Iseluleko esisebenzayo nezikhombi zokufundisa zokuphila iRamadan ngesikhathi sakho, ngokunethezeka.
library.articles.fastingqadaa-dispense-e: Ukubuyisa kanjani nokuthi nini izinsuku zokuzila eziphuthelwe, ngesivinini sakho nangaphandle kwecala.
library.articles.prayerduringmenstruatio: Kungani salat imiswa ngalesi sikhathi, nokuthi uphile kanjani lesi sikhathi ngokunethezeka.
library.articles.returningtoprayer-le-gh: Izinyathelo ezijwayelekile zokuqala kabusha salat ngemuva kwesikhathi sakho, ngokunethezeka.
library.articles.religiousfaq-questions-: Imibuzo evame kakhulu nge-fiqh yabesifazane, ibekwe endaweni eyodwa nezimpendulo ezicacile.
library.articles.religiousfaq-reperes-ap: Okushiwo isiko ngosizi lokulahlekelwa ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa nokubeletha, ngobumnene nozwelo.
